versions.subject: added rule for zLoader & Office
versions.detection:
sec_settings:
  EventID:
    - 12
    - 13
  TargetObject|endswith:
        - '*\Security\Trusted Documents\TrustRecords'
        - '*\Security\AccessVBOM'
        - '*\Security\VBAWarnings'
  EventType:
    - SetValue
    - DeleteValue
    - CreateValue
condition: sec_settings
versions.spl: EventID IN (12, 13) TargetObject IN ("*\\Security\\Trusted Documents\\TrustRecords", "*\\Security\\AccessVBOM", "*\\Security\\VBAWarnings") EventType IN ("SetValue", "DeleteValue", "CreateValue")
